evidence.languages_chinese: Written Chinese (strong plus: warehouse operations and the WMS development team communicate in Chinese).
evidence.must_have_skills_1: 3+ years product management on logistics, fulfilment, warehouse, or supply-chain software (WMS, OMS, 3PL platform, or adjacent).
evidence.must_have_skills_2: Has shipped integration-heavy product: APIs, webhooks, vendor systems, data sync between platforms.
evidence.must_have_skills_3: Technical fluency: can read a technical spec and hold their own in an engineering discussion about states, syncs, and edge cases.
evidence.nice_to_have_skills_1: Direct WMS vendor-management experience, from the implementation side or the vendor side.
evidence.nice_to_have_skills_2: Has run warehouse ops or worked physically close to a warehouse floor.
evidence.nice_to_have_skills_3: Has run a build-vs-buy evaluation or vendor RFP process before.
evidence.nice_to_have_skills_4: Uses AI tools as a working method (specs, QA planning, analysis), not just chat.
evidence.domain: The client is an AI-powered fulfilment and logistics ecosystem built for fast-growing e-commerce brands.
